levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن عتبة بن مسعود

notes: «- قال عبيد الله -» is the same man as the link before it, written again (rule 7), so it is not a new link.
«- وكانت من المهاجرات ... -» is a gloss on Umm Qays and is left out.
Umm Qays is the last link: she relays what she did with her son.
